name: Ebrahim Raisi
summary: A Shia cleric and judicial official who spent his career upholding the Islamic Republic and its guardianship of the jurist. He opposed Western-led order and the US, held that nuclear weapons have no place in Iran's doctrine, and defended family, religion and a resistance economy.

universal-healthcare.rationale: In his 2022 UN address he cites bringing universal health-care coverage to 85 million people as an example of the system pursuing the people's will.

self-reliance-over-aid.rationale: He says Iran learned to stand on its own feet and not depend on anyone, and produced its own vaccines and defence systems under sanctions.

independent-nuclear-deterrent.rationale: In 2021, 2022 and 2023 UN addresses and the 60 Minutes interview he states that nuclear weapons have no place in Iran's doctrine.

military-force-for-human-rights.rationale: He condemns coups, military interventionism and 'boots on the ground' and says freedom does not come in the backpacks of outside soldiers.

foreign-policy-non-interference.rationale: His closing principles in 2022 include respecting nations' will and refraining from direct engagement in their internal affairs.

troops-home-from-abroad.rationale: He says foreign military presence in the region is the problem itself and calls the US presence in Iraq and Syria the biggest hindrance, favouring regional security from within.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: He says regional security should come from cooperation not 'opposing blocs' and that new East-West divides should not be allowed to form.

dominated-front.rationale: He calls for a new order beyond Western hegemony and says sanctions bring targeted countries closer together.

multipolar-world.rationale: He says the world is moving away from a unilateral hegemonic order toward an equitable multilateral one with regional orders, and calls for it.

close-ties-china.rationale: As president he first sought to strengthen ties with China and Iran's neighbours before serious talks with the West.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: He calls Israel an occupying 'Zionist regime' and a false regime the US helps take root, and proposes one state for all Palestinians by referendum.

refugee-return.rationale: He says it is the right of Palestinians who were forced to leave their homes and homeland.

civilians-legitimate-targets.rationale: He repeatedly condemns the killing of women and children in war as crimes and says the Quran forbids all violence in human interactions.

war-builds-character.rationale: He says warfare leads to destruction, war is not the solution to crises, and dialogue is.

religious-offensive-war.rationale: He states that the Quran forbids all forms of violence in human interactions and that Iran supports no war anywhere.

martyrs-honoured.rationale: He honours Soleimani, Muhandis and Rajai as martyrs and the Arba'een pilgrimage commemorating Imam Hussain's martyrdom.

resist-oppression-despite-death.rationale: He praises those who gave their lives for human dignity and says Iran will never tolerate relationships based on oppression and will defend its rights.

death-penalty.rationale: He sat on the 1988 Tehran committee that judged prisoners during the mass executions, and later led the judiciary.

suppress-opposition.rationale: Britannica reports he played a key role in the crackdown on dissidents after 2009 and that his government clamped down on dissent; challengers were disqualified in 2021.

party-controls-media.rationale: Britannica reports his government stepped up surveillance and censorship during his presidency.

clerical-rule.rationale: A cleric and protégé of the Supreme Leader, he served in the Assembly of Experts (2007-24) and upheld Khomeini's guardianship of the jurist throughout his career.

divine-source-of-authority.rationale: He calls the Islamic Revolution a fulfilment of religious democracy and says the system rests on the people's will and divine teachings.

more-religion-public.rationale: He says rationality, justice and freedom cannot reach their purpose without spirituality and says the state rests on divine teachings.

spiritual-nature.rationale: He presents spirituality as essential to what the state offers the world and its people.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: He spent his career in the Islamic Republic's judiciary and presided over its courts as chief justice.

separate-church-state.rationale: He served for decades in the clerical system built on guardianship of the jurist and presents the Islamic Republic as founded on divine teachings.

traditional-family.rationale: He calls the family the fundamental column of human development and an attack on it a crime against humanity.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: He calls the sanctity of marriage between a man and a woman an inherent truth to be accepted by the whole world.

gender-social-construct.rationale: He says there are natural differences between men and women who complete each other.

sex-socially-constructed.rationale: He says there are natural differences between men and women.

institutions-fit-civilization.rationale: He says the project of imposing Westernized identity and universalizing American ideals failed.

promote-democracy-abroad.rationale: He says 'democracy' abroad has been a code word for coups, occupations and wars and calls the liberal democracy project a velvet glove on an iron hand.

democratic-peace.rationale: He says wars are fought in the name of defending democracy and that Western democracy has meant occupations and wars.

noblesse-oblige.rationale: He says the Quran calls on people to serve those who have less.

universal-morality.rationale: He says justice, rationality and shared human values are common to all Abrahamic religions and all nations.

scripture-inerrant.rationale: He calls the Quran the word of the Creator and says its divine truth is eternal and impervious.

religion-illusion.rationale: He holds that divine teachings give humans their highest values and cannot be extinguished.

state-promotes-atheism.rationale: He holds that spirituality is essential to human societies and calls for protecting religion.

unbroken-national-continuity.rationale: He calls Iranians inheritors of a civilization free for millennia and describes a continuous nation from the Babylonians on.

state-harmful.rationale: As president, chief justice and long-time official he built his career in the state's service.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: His first budget sharply increased funding for the defence establishment.

holocaust-denial.rationale: Asked about it he said there are some signs it happened and that it should be investigated by historians, neither confirming nor denying it.

notes: Themes searched: world, religion, family, nuclear doctrine, government record, economy (little first-hand text found). Evidence is mostly UN speeches and one interview; Only English texts were searched.
